title: The Communication Tool Avalanche: Thresholded Signal Externalization, Event-Driven Orchestration, and Coherence per Joule
registered: 2026-11-23, locked with SHA-256 sidecar strictly prior to executing CTA-E1, CTA-E2, and CTA-E3 hardware runs

hardware_and_telemetry.cpu_model: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900H (20 logical threads, Linux x86_64)

rapl_domains.pkg_reported_j: sysfs powercap intel-rapl:0 (package-0 MSR PKG_ENERGY_STATUS, wrap-safe 262.143 J range)
rapl_domains.core_reported_j: sysfs powercap intel-rapl:0:0 (core MSR PP0_ENERGY_STATUS, wrap-safe 262.143 J range)
rapl_domains.psys_reported_j: sysfs powercap intel-rapl:1 (psys MSR PLATFORM_ENERGY_COUNTER; OEM EC firmware reports fixed ~0.20 W quiescent stub on this host, logged verbatim alongside dynamic package-0 and core rails)

hardware_and_telemetry.remote_cloud_server_energy: not_available (kept strictly separate from local RAPL reported_j; token counts and USD reported explicitly)

CTA-E1.description: 16-node heterogeneous attested orchestration DAG under bursty arrivals across 1%, 5%, and 20% duty cycles (10.0 s windows x 5 replicates)
regimes: event_threshold (Linux eventfd blocking wakeup strictly when weighted potential V_u >= theta_u)
poll_10hz (100 ms periodic clock tick across 16 node threads)
poll_100hz (10 ms periodic clock tick across 16 node threads)
poll_1000hz (1 ms periodic clock tick across 16 node threads)

CTA-E2.description: 60-task multi-category Python code-repair benchmark (20 syntax/import, 20 scope/type/API, 20 algorithmic/state-machine logic; >= 8 held-out test vectors + repeat state-isolation check per task) across 4 arms (240 episodes)

arms.arm_a_det_only: 5 deterministic kernels (parse, static_type_scope, test_gen, det_patch, diff_verifier) with 0 model calls
arms.arm_b_monolithic_llm: Direct single-shot Claude Sonnet 5.5 on all 60 tasks without deterministic pre-filter or verifier commit gate
arms.arm_c_unattested_4agent: Unverified 4-agent natural-language chain (Planner -> Coder -> Reviewer -> Summarizer) on all 60 tasks without BLAKE3+Ed25519 channel attestation or verifier commit gate
arms.arm_d_cta_orchestrator: SSP min-cost flow + thresholded integrate-and-fire heterogeneous pool + Rust BLAKE3+Ed25519 edge receipts + targeted Claude Sonnet 5.5 escalation (<= 2 bounded turns) + Differential Verifier Commit Gate

CTA-E2.primary_metric: Coherence per Joule (CpJ = verified_correct_tasks / pkg_reported_j), reported alongside pass_rate_pct, false_commit_rate_pct, core_reported_j, psys_reported_j, total_tokens, and api_cost_usd

CTA-E3.description: 200 Byzantine/corrupted channel injections (50 payload bit-flips, 50 spoofed sender IDs, 50 truncated JSON/AST frames, 50 semantic regression patches) + 20 mid-stream node dropouts forcing SSP min-cost flow topology recomputation

falsifiers.F1_polling_energy_tax: Event-driven threshold firing fails to lower both OS thread wakeups and package-0 reported_j relative to 100 Hz and 1,000 Hz clocked polling at 1% and 5% duty cycles, or suffers worse p50/p99 latency than 10 Hz and 100 Hz polling.
falsifiers.F2_attestation_overhead: Compiled Rust BLAKE3 (256-bit) + Ed25519 (64-byte RFC 8032) channel verification exceeds 100 us or 5 mJ per edge up to 64 KiB payloads.
falsifiers.F3_oracle_leakage: Any arm or internal kernel accesses HOLD_OUT_ORACLES or reference solutions prior to final post-commit scoring.
falsifiers.F4_coherence_per_joule: CTA-Orchestrator (Arm D) fails to match or exceed Monolithic-LLM (Arm B) and Unattested-4-Agent (Arm C) verified pass rate, or fails to improve Coherence per Joule and false-commit rate.
falsifiers.F5_byzantine_containment: Any of the 200 corrupted channel events produces a downstream corrupt commit in CTA-Orchestrator, or SSP topology re-routing across 20 node dropouts exceeds 1,000 us.
falsifiers.F6_idle_baseline_drift: Pre- vs. post-experiment 5.0 s quiet idle package-0 power drifts by > 10.0%; if triggered, derived idle-subtracted net joules are flagged and withheld while raw reported_j values are preserved.
